name: MedAgentBench
description: MedAgentBench is a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to benchmark the agent capabilities of large language models in medical electronic health record (EHR) environments. It includes 300 patient-specific clinically-derived tasks, realistic patient profiles, and a FHIR-compliant interactive environment to simulate real-world medical agent tasks.
reputation: Publicly available and designed to track progress in medical LLM agent capabilities; best model achieves 69.67% success rate.
notes: Includes realistic patient data and interactive environment compatible with modern EMR systems.
